title: Claude's Gmail connector
what_status_means: template: the draft for a deployment shape, before anybody has corrected the mandate. draft: a copy made for one organisation, mandate not yet corrected. corrected: the mandate has been elicited from the deployer and a named owner has signed the licence.
agent: Claude, with the Gmail connector enabled and nothing else — Calendar and Drive are separate toggles and left off in this shape
shape_note: Not published at abp.sgit.ai: authored here from Anthropic's and Google's own pages (see data/grant.json provenance), scoped to Gmail alone — the Google Workspace connectors are toggled individually in Claude. Four rows measured on 2026-09-16 by the deployer on an account they run: sign-in, read, one send to an address they named, and the label inventory. The record is in evidence/.
